<?php
$owner = new class { public const int A = 4, B = 7; private const string LABEL = 'own'; public function make() { return new class(self::A + self::B, self::LABEL) { public function __construct(public int $value, public string $label) {} }; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $child->value, ';', $child->label, ';';

<?php
interface R183Factory { public function make(): object; }
$owner = new class implements R183Factory { public function make(): object { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $after::class, ';', ($owner instanceof R183Factory), ';';

<?php
interface R183First {} interface R183Second {}
$owner = new class implements r183first, R183Second { public function make() { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', ($owner instanceof R183First), ';', ($owner instanceof R183Second), ';';

<?php
class R183Base { protected function __construct() {} } interface R183Contract { public function make(): object; }
$owner = new class extends R183Base implements R183Contract { public function __construct() {} public function make(): object { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
trait R183Data { public const int VALUE = 11; public int $value = 5; public function label() { return 'trait'; } }
$owner = new class { use R183Data; public function make() { return new class($this->value, self::VALUE) { public function __construct(public int $left, public int $right) {} }; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $child->left, ';', $child->right, ';', $owner->label(), ';';

<?php
trait R183A { public function label() { return 'A'; } } trait R183B { public function label() { return 'B'; } }
$owner = new class { use R183A, R183B { R183A::label insteadof R183B; R183B::label as private other; } public function make() { echo $this->label(), $this->other(), ';'; return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
trait R183String { public function __toString(): string { return 'TRAIT;'; } }
$owner = new class { use R183String; public function make() { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo (string)$owner, ($owner instanceof Stringable), ';', $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
interface R183Maker { public function make(): Closure; } trait R183Value { public const int VALUE = 17; }
$owner = new class implements R183Maker { use R183Value; public const int OTHER = 6; public function make(): Closure { return fn() => new class(self::VALUE + self::OTHER) { public function __construct(public int $value) {} }; } };
$f = $owner->make(); unset($owner); $child = $f(); echo $child::class, ';', $child->value, ';';

<?php
interface R183Readonly {} trait R183ReadonlyValue { public const int VALUE = 19; }
$owner = new readonly class implements R183Readonly { use R183ReadonlyValue; public function make() { return new readonly class(self::VALUE) { public function __construct(public int $value) {} }; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';', $child->value, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public const CB = self::value(...); public static function value() { return 'CALL;'; } public function make() { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); $f = $owner::CB; echo $f(), $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
trait R183Const { public const int VALUE = 3; }
$owner = new class { use R183Const; public const int VALUE = 3; public function make() { return new class {}; } };
$child = $owner->make(); echo $owner::VALUE, ';', $owner::class, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
echo 'PRE;'; trait R183Conflict { public const int VALUE = 3; }
$owner = new class(argument183()) { use R183Conflict; public const int VALUE = 4; public function make() { return new class {}; } };
function argument183() { echo 'BAD;'; return 1; }

<?php
echo 'PRE;'; interface R183Need { public function required(): int; }
$owner = new class(argument183()) implements R183Need { public function make() { return new class {}; } };
function argument183() { echo 'BAD;'; return 1; }

<?php
echo 'PRE;'; interface R183Duplicate {}
$owner = new class(argument183()) implements R183Duplicate, R183Duplicate { public function make() { return new class {}; } };
function argument183() { echo 'BAD;'; return 1; }

<?php
echo 'PRE;';
$owner = new class { public function make() { return new class { final private function hidden() {} }; } public const int VALUE = 'bad'; };

<?php
echo 'PRE;'; interface R183Priority { public function required(): int; }
$owner = new class implements R183Priority { public function make() { return new class { public function invalid(int $value = 'bad') {} }; } };
